questions.text: What brings you in today? Please describe your main problem.
questions.text_hi: आज आप क्यों आए हैं? अपनी मुख्य समस्या बताएं।

questions.text: How long have you had this problem?
questions.text_hi: यह समस्या कितने समय से है?

questions.text: On a scale of 1 to 10, how severe is your discomfort right now? 1 is very mild, 10 is unbearable.
questions.text_hi: 1 से 10 के पैमाने पर, अभी आपकी तकलीफ कितनी है?

questions.text: Where exactly do you feel this discomfort? Point to the area if possible.
Are you currently taking any medications? If yes, please name them.
questions.text_hi: क्या आप अभी कोई दवाई ले रहे हैं?

questions.text: Do you have any known allergies to medicines or food?
questions.text_hi: क्या आपको किसी दवाई या खाने से एलर्जी है?
